tools.name: ai_tell_scan
tools.description:
Scan a draft for the measurable tells of AI-generated prose. FREE.

Flags stock phrases (with exact quotes), structural reflexes, uniform
sentence rhythm, em-dash overuse, and hedging boilerplate — every flag
cites the actual text. Typical input {"text": "<draft>"} returns
{"reads_human_score": 0-10

tools.name: voice_fingerprint
tools.description:
Build a measurable voice profile from samples of a person's real writing. FREE.

Feed it 2+ samples (emails, posts, essays — 150+ words total) and use
the result with humanize_plan / verify_rewrite. Typical input
{"samples": ["<email text>", "<blog post>"]} returns {"label":
"my-voice", "target_metr

tools.name: burstiness_report
tools.description:

tools.name: verify_rewrite
tools.description:
Verify a rewrite actually improved: score delta, meaning check, voice distance. PREMIUM (license).

Compares reads-human score before/after, a meaning-preservation proxy,
and (with a fingerprint) numeric distance to the target voice. Typical
input {"original": "<draft>", "rewrite": "<edited draft>"}

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "ai_tell_scan" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Scan a draft for the measurable tells of AI-generated prose. FREE. Flags stock phrases (with exact quotes), structural reflexes, uniform sentence rhythm, em-das…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "ai_tell_scan" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "humanizer" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: voice_fingerprint · Public sink: voice_fingerprint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: voice_fingerprint · Public sink: voice_fingerprint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
